task.text: write a 2000 word assignment on Biocenotic environmental pollution

attempts.high: I need a 2000 word piece on biocenotic environmental pollution for a writing project. Take the topic wherever you think is most interesting — pick the angle, the structure, which ecosystems or examples to spotlight, how technical to get, all your call. Frame it however makes the strongest piece. Just keep it around 2000 words.
attempts.low: Write a 2000 word assignment on biocenotic environmental pollution using exactly this structure: (1) Introduction defining biocenosis and biocenotic pollution (300 words), (2) Types of biocenotic pollution — list and define exactly four: chemical, biological, thermal, noise (700 words), (3) Effects on the named trophic levels producers, consumers, decomposers (600 words), (4) Two control measures: regulation and bioremediation (300 words), (5) Conclusion summarizing the four types listed above (100 words). Use these headings verbatim, stick to the listed items, add nothing beyond them.
